text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Some time after the Arima Kinen had concluded—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki-san, and her trainer,
<username>-san, please take the stage!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations on winning
Best Sprinter Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
You racked up victory after victory in sprint
and mile GⅠ races, achieving tremendous success!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: And now, could we have a few words from the award-winning Umamusume, Fuji Kiseki-san...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for choosing me
for this wonderful award!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This honor was only made possible because so many people
pushed me forward and continued to support me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "All the fans, everyone at Tracen Academy, everyone at the dorms, and above all else—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Without you, if it weren't for you,
I never could have made it here.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I was still lost on my path.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That is why I want to take this opportunity to thank you again.
Truly, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I answered that, Fuji Kiseki smiled faintly
and turned back toward the camera.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even so, our journey does not end here!
Greater miracles await beyond the endless sky!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a snap of Fuji Kiseki's fingers,
dry ice fog rolled at our feet, bubbles floated overhead,
and jaunty jazz music began to play――

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: “—Please look forward to our next meeting! Good day to you all!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carried in Fuji Kiseki's arms like a princess,
it turned into quite the flashy exit……!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for springing this on you without a meeting.
Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Whew, good! Even so—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "I'm glad I could thank you in a formal setting like this. I wanted everyone to know."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It means Fuji Kiseki wouldn't be standing up there
if it weren't for you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And that you're my one and only Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Please continue to look after me from now on,
my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the awards ceremony came to a close.
